{{Quote|The city is ours, General, except for one fortress. We can't get past its shields.''"<br />"''Continue landing your troops. That shield is being taken care of.|A B1 battle droid and Grievous|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen">''[[The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen]]''</ref>}}
This '''fortress''' served as the home for the [[Unidentified King of Falleen|King of Falleen]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Fall of Falleen|invaded]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], and while [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] lured the [[King/Legends|king]] out of his castle by dueling his [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was able to capture the king and force him to surrender.
